title: Airport Flex Park LOI
summary: Non-binding LOI at $7,200,000 with a $150,000 deposit, 45 days of due diligence and closing 30 days later, no financing contingency.

evidence.quote: This letter of intent is dated October 20, 2025.

fields.value: Model Fund I – Airport Flex LLC

evidence.quote: The Buyer is Model Fund I – Airport Flex LLC and the Seller is Runway Vista Holdings LP.
The Buyer is Model Fund I – Airport Flex LLC and the Seller is Runway Vista Holdings LP.
Buyer will deposit $150,000 in escrow within three business days of the PSA.
Buyer will have a due diligence period of 45 days.
Closing will occur 30 days after the end of due diligence.
This letter expires if not countersigned by October 27, 2025.
